ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New business, Proposal and later stages need Budget confirmed, Amount and Contract term (months).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_business", CASE(StageName, "Qualified", 1, "Discovery", 2, "Solution fit", 3, "Technical validation", 4, "Proposal", 5, "Negotiation (New business)", 6, "Contract out", 7, "Closed won", 8, 0) >= 5, OR(NOT(Budget_confirmed__c), ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(Contract_term_months__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Budget confirmed, Amount and Contract term (months) before moving to Proposal.
